The canaliculi were observed using the CDFDA assay and by immunostaining, and the bar graph shows the average area of each bile canaliculus stained by anti-BSEP, presented as means ± SD (n=3).

Histology shows dead and dying cells detached from the spheroid periphery and empty regions within the microtissues indicative of cell loss.
